title: M0 — Repository foundation
description: Issue-driven development is operational: repository documentation, forms, labels, milestones, implementation backlog, PR metadata gate, and main branch protection. No runtime image delivery in this milestone.

title: v0.1.0 — AL2023 runtime prototype
description: Accept the runtime contract and licensing approach; lock official AL2023 inputs; assemble amd64 static/base rootfs; pass final-container workload and absent-tool tests. Exit: auditable local prototype, not a supported published image.

title: v0.2.0 — Multi-architecture CI
description: Build and validate linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, automate unprivileged PR builds, and document reproducibility and size measurements. Exit: both architectures pass the same runtime contract and stable file-manifest checks.

title: v1.0.0 — Verifiable stable release
description: Ship complete SBOM/provenance/license evidence, vulnerability policy, signed immutable GHCR releases, update/rollback procedures, and consumer examples. Exit: both architectures satisfy the published support and release contract.

title: v1.1.0 — Runtime extensions
description: After v1.0, evaluate C++ runtime support, isolated debugging, and language-runtime proposals. Each extension requires an accepted contract and maintenance plan; language images are not promised by this milestone.
